skill_name: Analyze a given article on the impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education and explain its main points.
workflow: The main points of the article are that AI is transforming the way students learn by providing them with personalized and dynamic learning experiences. It can also offer more accurate feedback on student performance and help automate tedious tasks such as grading and student assessment. Additionally, it can help identify areas where students are struggling and individualize instruction to help them become more successful.
